about_the_game:
Combat even more evolved. A trial serum turned Lazarus into a deadly blend of woman and machine. She’s the peak of evolution, and she’s ready to challenge anyone (or anything) that says otherwise.

Content included:


  • Lazarus
  • 4 agent skins
  • 5 weapon skins
  • 1 Gremlin tech
  • 1 vehicle skin
  • 1 unlock mission
  • 1 personal mission
